title: Happy Together Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Enter the condo through your own private lobby and private elevator that opens directly into your luxurious suite (only 2 units in this building) .
description_expanded: Private Arrival & Elevated Coastal LivingEnter through your private lobby and dedicated elevator, which opens directly into your exclusive luxury residence—one of only two units in the building. From the moment you arrive, privacy and refinement set the tone. Step inside to discover a beautifully renovated kitchen featuring quartz countertops, a spacious center island, a Wolf six-burner gas range, a Sub-Zero stainless steel refrigerator, KitchenAid ice maker, and a striking white farmhouse-style cast iron sink—perfectly designed for both entertaining and everyday coastal living.Open-Concept Living with Gulf ViewsThe expansive living area is bathed in natural light, framed by multiple windows and French doors that showcase stunning Gulf of Mexico views. Plush seating invites relaxed gatherings with friends and family, complemented by a large flat-screen TV and a sleeper sofa for additional guests. Just beyond the living space, step onto the private, covered balcony, an ideal setting for sunrise coffee, sunset cocktails, and uninterrupted views of Seaside’s emerald waters.Flowing seamlessly from the living area, the open dining space comfortably seats six to eight guests and sits at the heart of the floor plan—connecting the living room and kitchen so everyone can stay together during meals and memorable moments.Thoughtfully Designed Sleeping SpacesDown the hall, the king primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a dedicated seating area, large flat-screen TV, and ample storage. The recently renovated ensuite bath feels spa-like, featuring limestone countertops, double vanities, and a spacious walk-in steam shower—a true luxury after long days at the beach.The second bedroom is a versatile bunk suite, designed to sleep three with a queen bed on the bottom and a twin above. An updated full hall bath with a tub/shower combination is conveniently located nearby, serving both guests and the bunk room.A Seaside Stay to RememberWith the turquoise waters of the Gulf as your daily backdrop and the privacy of a boutique luxury residence, this Seaside condo delivers comfort, style, and location in equal measure. From effortless beach days to quiet evenings on the balcony, every detail comes together for a stay where you truly can’t help but be Happy Together.* Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter.FEATURES1,790 square feet, located in Seaside’s Central SquareSeaside beach access at Coleman Pavilion308 feet or a 1-minute walk to beach accessRenovated kitchen with premium appliancesThis home streams live TV through YouTubeTV, so you can catch local channels, sports, and favorite shows right from the smart TVsKitchenAid freestanding ice maker, Wolf 6-burner gas stove, and Sub-Zero refrigeratorWasher and dryerPeacock Alley Linens – fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityA golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided1 parking spot designated for the unit directly to the left of the entry door to the elevator hallway. 2 parking passes are provided for the guest. The additional car can park anywhere around Smolian Circle without having to pay for parking with a displayed parking pass on the rearview mirrorPets not allowed
